title: chrysothamnus parryi subsp. vulcanicus
intro: Chrysothamnus parryi subsp. vulcanicus, commonly known as Desert Chrysanthemum, is a plant species native to the southwestern United States. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Desert Chrysanthemum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. However, more research is needed to fully understand the health benefits and therapeutic actions of Chrysothamnus parryi subsp. vulcanicus.
